tokens.name: sala-0
tokens.usage: Page background: the darkened room. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: sala-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the collection hero, search field, license notes.

tokens.name: sala-2
tokens.usage: Posters without art, secondary buttons, hover fills, the player before it loads.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, chips, secondary buttons): at least 3:1 on sala-0, sala-1 and sala-2.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, at the veil opacity over images: a warm mid grey that stays legible on light and dark frames.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on sala-0, sala-1, sala-2 and plata-soft. Also the fill of a selected chip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (director, duration, year) and secondary copy, on sala-0, sala-1 and sala-2.

tokens.name: tungsteno
tokens.usage: Neon pink, the marquee light. The one action color: primary buttons, active states, the focus ring. Never decoration. (The token keeps its first name, tungsteno.)

tokens.name: tungsteno-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a primary button.

tokens.name: tungsteno-text
tokens.usage: Accent text (eyebrows, 'Ver todo' links) on sala-0, sala-1 and tungsteno-soft. An alias of tungsteno.

tokens.name: on-tungsteno
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tungsteno fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: tungsteno-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind tungsteno-text (accent badges such as 'Nuevo').

tokens.name: telon
tokens.usage: The curtain. Reserved for sponsored collections: their hero and their posters. Nothing else is wine.

tokens.name: on-telon
tokens.usage: All text and outlines on telon.

tokens.name: plata
tokens.usage: Silver screen. Legal and informational marks: license route, subtitle badges. As text on sala-0, sala-1 and plata-soft.

tokens.name: plata-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind plata text (info badges).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and broken embeds in the admin. Always with a word, never color alone.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at 75 % width: condensed poster capitals, like a title card. Always uppercase, used with restraint.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Collection hero title. One per screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Short title on its page and on the player.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Rail headings.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Title on a typographic poster.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: Rank number of a Top 10 item (1 to 9): its digits stand as tall as the card (0.7em at 224px ≈ 157px); the 0.67 line height puts their baseline on the box's bottom edge.

styles.name: rank-two
styles.usage: Rank number 10: two digits, tighter.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo at its normal width: one family for headings, controls and copy (the logo keeps Big Shoulders, as outlines).

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Cinco cortos que ganaron el Goya y se pueden ver gratis, de forma legal.
styles.usage: Synopses and collection descriptions.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Short title under a poster.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Director and secondary metadata, in ink-muted.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Se reproduce desde el canal de YouTube de su productora.
styles.usage: License text, player message, chips and rail actions.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Filter chips and rail actions.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Button label (sm), in the site header.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label (md).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Button label (lg), in heroes and on the player.

styles.name: credit
styles.usage: Director on a typographic poster.

styles.name: meta-strong
styles.usage: The sponsor's name in a sponsor credit.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Links of the site header.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: Archivo with tabular figures, so durations and counts line up.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Durations, always formatted with Intl (unit: minute).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, eyebrows and the sponsor credit label, uppercase.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Year on a typographic poster and the sponsor label.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No space: resets margins and insets.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Between a card's title and its metadata line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; poster title to credit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons; poster padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards in a rail; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Component padding; poster perforation inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding; between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between rails on a page.

radius.note: Screens are rectangles: corners stay small.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, perforations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Posters, stills, cards, notes and menus. Large surfaces and the player use radius-hero.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: Large surfaces: the heroes (short, collection, showcase), the collection page header and the player.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips only.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and text fields: pill-shaped. Set it to the value of radius-sm (4px) for squared controls.

shadow.note: Light falls from the screen: shadows are deep and soft in the dark theme.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Posters at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Poster lifted on hover or focus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and TV-remote focus on every interactive element: a gap in sala-0, then a 2px tungsteno ring.

tokens.name: ratio-poster
tokens.usage: Portrait posters: the typographic poster in the heroes.

tokens.name: ratio-still
tokens.usage: Stills, the player, the collection hero art and the thumbnail of every short card.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Button height (sm): the site header.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Button height (md).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Button height (lg).

tokens.name: control-search
tokens.usage: Search field height; also its left inset for the icon.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Badge height.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Short card width in rails; the minimum column of a grid of cards (16:9 thumbnails).

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Narrow column: the footer brand column, the genres menu, a logo or a poster in a preview.

tokens.name: perforation
tokens.usage: Width of the film-perforation strip on a poster.

tokens.name: perforation-hole
tokens.usage: Height of one perforation hole (pitch is twice this).

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icon in rail actions.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon in sm buttons, pagination arrows and the header search's clear button.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icon in the search field.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon in md buttons and the header magnifier.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Icon in lg buttons.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: How far a poster rises on hover or focus.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: How far a button sinks while pressed.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the home hero when it has a backdrop image.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed site header: anchors scroll this far below the top.

tokens.name: rank-overlap
tokens.usage: How far a Top 10 card covers the right side of its rank number.

container.note: Maximum widths for content and text measures.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content.

tokens.name: article
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a short's page.

tokens.name: search
tokens.usage: Search field.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: License note.

tokens.name: hero-text
tokens.usage: Collection description and short synopsis in the heroes.

tokens.name: hero-poster
tokens.usage: The featured short's poster in the home hero.

tokens.name: player-text
tokens.usage: Message on the player gate.

tokens.name: synopsis
tokens.usage: Synopsis on a short's page.

breakpoint.note: Layout switches. Mobile first: styles apply from this width up.

tokens.name: md
tokens.usage: Hero goes from one to two columns.

motion.note: Only posters and pressed buttons move. Everything stops with prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-lift
tokens.usage: Poster lift on hover or focus; a short card's expansion.

tokens.name: scale-card
tokens.usage: How much a short card grows on hover or focus, to show its details.

tokens.name: layer-card
tokens.usage: Stacking order of the expanded short card, above its neighbours.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Button hover fill and press.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.

tokens.name: perforation
tokens.usage: Film perforation strip.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Sponsor label on telon and poster year.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the dark gradient over stills (short card, hero), so text on them reads over any image.

tokens.name: poster-dim
tokens.usage: A typographic poster under an expanded short card: its own text steps back for the card's details.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill: the veil colour at this opacity, so the image behind shows through, blurred.

tokens.name: veil-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Behind translucent secondary buttons: the blur, more than the fill, is what makes them read.
